what_i_did: Midjourney drew end | long face | end, so views/ uses the long latch face as front (-Y), the left end as side (+X), and the long face mirrored as back (the sheet has no back view); prep_views.py also clips the cast shadows that touched the image edges and would have counted as object.

Every weft strand is a thin one-quad strip (1.5 cm tall, twice the rows of the first pass) whose depth goes over and under at each 5 cm stake, offset one stake per row and per face. The diving half of each cell is a ReedShade about 12% darker, and a mid-tone core behind the gaps keeps them as fine lines. The result reads as fine, even wicker rather than a checkerboard.
Lid on top, on a hinge

The lid is a separate pivot at the back edge of the rim. It has a fat rolled bottom band (3.1 cm) that overhangs the body, two stepped-in bands above it for a rounded shoulder, a domed woven top, a top roll and rope lashings at the hinge. A matching fat rolled band runs round the base.

The rope is laid-rope style: a 6-sided twisting profile with fat bulges and tight pinches. Handles are knotted through both ends. The latch is a loop tied to the lid front that drops over a wooden toggle, ending in a coiled knot and a tapering hanging tail.
0.70 m long body (0.87 m with handles), 0.33 m deep, 0.44 m tall, slight inward taper to the base; measured from the turnaround and tuned on IoU.
Honey wicker #B9763F for the reed (the render's mean comes out at sRGB 183,118,72), with rims a little darker and a 12% darker under-shade.
good: Fine, even wicker on the walls and lid at 4,178 triangles: strands at twice the earlier density with soft over/under contrast.
The lid sits fitted on top and actually opens on its back hinge, which fixes the live version's bug where the lid lies flat beside the box.
The silhouette still matches the sheet: front/back IoU 0.958, end 0.918.
The body is hollow (dark interior and floor), so the open lid shows a real basket and not a solid block.
off: The fatter overhanging lid band and base roll cost a little IoU on the end view (0.937 to 0.918), because the sheet's end view has a slimmer lid lip. I kept them because the art director asked for them and the hero shows them.
Only the lowest lid band carries wrap ridges; the other rims are smooth tubes.
On the lid top, the over/under steps leave small dark diamonds between rows, which read slightly more like openwork than the hero's dense lid weave.
Handles follow the turnaround (angled out and up from the end rims) more than the hero, where one handle stands upright above the lid.
The back view is the mirrored front because the sheet has none, so the 'back' IoU just repeats the front.

rounds.change: First build: woven panels (6.4 cm stakes, shallow over/under), 2 lid bands, 0.70 x 0.39 x 0.39 m. Too light and too flat, the weave read as stripes.
Colours converted from hero sRGB to linear (much darker), deeper and chunkier over/under with shaded under-strands, 3 lid bands, depth 0.36 m, height 0.30 m.
Proportions from the sheet: depth 0.33 m, body 0.31 m; handles raised; lid core plate dropped below the weave so it no longer pokes through.
Removed the profile twist on the rims (it pinched the lid bands and made the lid look ajar), made the body hollow, added ridged rims (4,224 tris, over budget).
Back under budget: wrap ridges and alternating shade only on the lowest lid band; core plate corners tucked inside the top roll.
Bigger lid overhang and taper, steeper handles: the end view improved but the front dropped because the handles stopped defining its width.
Overhang 1.6 cm, taper 1.0 cm, handles 8.5 cm out: overshot.
Handles 6.8 cm out (swept 6.2 / 6.8 cm); latch loop now swings on its own pivot; single scene clip. Final 768 px render: front 0.965, side 0.937, back 0.965.

Art director craft round. Thinner strands at twice the rows (1.5 cm) with the under-shade only about 12% darker and a mid-tone core. Fatter rolled lid band that overhangs the body, and a fatter base roll. Chunkier laid-rope handles and latch, with a knot and hanging tail. Honey #B9763F wicker with slightly darker rims. 4,178 tris; final 768 px render: front 0.958, side 0.918, back 0.958.

moving_parts: One 120-frame, 24 fps seamless clip ('Scene'). The lid rotates on a hinge at the back edge of the rim: it rests (1-18), lifts 72 degrees (18-44), holds open (44-76), closes (76-102) with a small landing bounce (102-112), and rests to 120. The latch loop hangs from a pivot at its knot on the lid front: it lags behind the lid, swings past plumb, settles hanging down while the lid is open, and drops back over the toggle peg as the lid closes.
creative_additions: Real over/under strand geometry instead of a flat colour; a hollow interior; rope lashings at the hinge; a wrapped lid band; a latch knot with a hanging tail; the latch loop's lagging swing; a domed lid top.
